entries.15b85d34cd2f661e: A medium-term management plan was formulated in November 2021, aiming to establish a “One Step Higher Career Job-Change Market” under the “type” brand. entries.171216df61b18f02: A single segment, the staffing services business, which operates 5 businesses: the Media & Information Business, Placement Business, New Graduate Media Business, New Graduate Placement Business and IT Dispatch Business.
